name: windows_share
shortdesc: Resource agent for Windows network shares
longdesc:
This resource agent manages a Windows network share using the
net share command. On start it creates the share if it does not
already exist. On stop it removes the share.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.longdesc:
The local directory path to expose as a network share,
e.g. D:\SharedData.

parameters.name: sharename
parameters.longdesc:
The name of the network share as it will appear on the network,
e.g. SharedData.

parameters.name: grant
parameters.longdesc:
Optional access permissions passed as the /GRANT argument to
net share. Format is user,permission, e.g. Administrator,FULL
or Everyone,READ. If not specified, default Windows share
permissions apply.
